title: Immunization Services Desk Training Casebook - Outside Dose 1 Entries in a Rebuilt Dose Count
content:
**Immunization Services training module: which dose 1 entries recorded from another provider stand and which are set aside when a course's valid doses still needed are rebuilt after a dose on it is found not to count.**

### The rule the cases apply

> Dose 1 entries recorded from another provider are handled as follows. Where every such entry carries a lot number and Kestrel gave a later dose of the course at one of its stores, they all stand. Where at least one such entry carries no lot number and Kestrel gave a later dose of the course at one of its stores, only the entries without a lot number are set aside. In every other case every dose 1 entry recorded from another provider is set aside.

### Terms

- **Dose 1 entry recorded from another provider**: a dose-given entry for dose 1 on the course that names no Kestrel store.
- **Carries a lot number**: the entry records the vaccine lot number; a blank lot number means it carries none.
- **Kestrel gave a later dose of the course at one of its stores**: the course holds at least 1 dose 2 or dose 3 entry that names a Kestrel store.

### Points of judgement

| Kestrel dose 2 or dose 3 at one of its stores | Outside dose 1 entries without a lot number | Outside dose 1 entries set aside |
|---|---|---|
| At least 1 | none | none; they all stand |
| At least 1 | at least 1 | only those without a lot number |
| None | any | every outside dose 1 entry |

### Casebook (all cases hypothetical)

**Case 1.** A Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series course holds one dose 1 entry from another provider with a lot number, and a dose 2 given at a Kestrel store. Every outside dose 1 entry carries a lot number and Kestrel gave a later dose: none is set aside.

**Case 2.** A course holds two dose 1 entries from other providers, one with a lot number and one without, and a dose 2 given at a Kestrel store. At least one outside dose 1 entry has no lot number and Kestrel gave a later dose: the one entry without a lot number is set aside; the other stands.

**Case 3.** A course holds one dose 1 entry from another provider with a lot number, and its dose 2 is also an entry from another provider. Kestrel gave no later dose at one of its stores: the outside dose 1 entry is set aside, although it carries a lot number.

**Case 4.** A course's only dose 1 entry names a Kestrel store. There is no outside dose 1 entry, so nothing is set aside under this rule in any case.

### Questions answered

- *Does a lot number alone keep an outside dose 1 entry?* Only where Kestrel gave a dose 2 or dose 3 of the course at one of its stores; without such a dose every outside dose 1 entry is set aside.
- *Does a Kestrel dose 1 count as a later dose?* No. The later dose must be dose 2 or dose 3 given at a Kestrel store.
